ShortDescription.Value: Unlock all Signature, place multiple Unique buildings, and customize city-wide and local effects to be vanilla or non-stacking bonuses.

Publish.LongDescription:
# 🏙️ ## Realistic Signature Buildings Fix
**Unlimited buildings without making the economy unrealistic and broken!**
Duplicate Signature buildings stack strong city-wide bonuses, making CS2's economy too easy.
### 1. Control City-wide bonuses: 3 choices
- **Vanilla Stacking:** every copy has normal game bonuses. Want super-easy mode? Keep stacking! - **First Copy Only (mod default):** only one copy of each building contributes city-wide bonuses. More Realistic, 5 building copies no longer has 5x stacked bonuses! - **No City Bonuses:** disable Signature city-wide bonuses for a bigger challenge.
### 2. Nearby Local Effects — Separate controls! - Keep neighborhood "aoe" benefits w/out stacking multiplying whole city broken bonuses! - Choose **Vanilla, First-Copy Only, or Off** independent of your city-wide bonus setting.
### 3. More Options - You choose! :white_check_mark: Allow unlimited unique buildings. no need for 3 mods just to deal with signature/unique buildings economy + placement rules. :white_check_mark: QoL, Hide mass unlock pop-ups: Stop the Spam when unlocking many Signature buildings at once. Save your click finger! :white_check_mark: Unlock all buildings without meeting requirements: population, zoning, or progression. I want it NOW! :white_check_mark: See Clearly: hide auto infoview overlays when placing Unique buildings, disables colored ground overlay and black-out of buildings! You can still open infoviews manually as needed or disable this toggle [x] in Options menu (was a player request).
### Compatibile - Compatible with **Anarchy**, including its multiple unique setting. - Safe to remove: existing building copies stay, normal vanilla rules return. No Harmony patching, all vanilla. - Avoid conflicts. See Options status, mod detects if you have duplicate mod installed.
### Notes - Hover over Options menu rows for explanations (on 3rd panel to the right). - To read diagnostic results: Options > About > Debug / Logging > Open Log.
## Support and Feedback - Support by clicking Like (top right), no donations requested, just a like for many days of work. - For feedback, use the [Discord](https://discord.gg/gwXgvtyhjc) | [GitHub](https://github.com/River-Mochi/CS2-RealisticSignature) links on this page. PRs are welcome, GPL-3.0 license.
